# zStudio

> zStudio is a visual scene editor for web games that AI tools can drive. It has a built-in MCP server, so any AI tool that supports MCP can build full scenes in it. Scenes are designed once — by hand or by AI — and exported to run in Pixi.js, Phaser, or plain HTML with no hand-written layout code.

zStudio is built by zStudios Ltd. It targets game developers, UI/UX artists and studios who build responsive, portrait/landscape-aware game interfaces (menus, HUDs, shop screens, popups, playable ads). Through MCP an AI can create containers, import images, Spine and particles, anchor elements for portrait and landscape, build buttons and other components, animate on the timeline, generate images and export. Skills (Markdown files) teach the AI a studio's own conventions. Local AI image models (Stable Diffusion, SDXL, FLUX, Z-Image, Qwen-Image) run on the user's own computer. zStudio is free to download and use, with no plans or tiers: the editor, MCP server, skills and local image models cost nothing and need no account. Cloud image models and the built-in AI Chat need a free account and are paid for with credits. Scenes are exported as JSON/assets and loaded at runtime via the open-source zImporter library.

## Product

- [Home](https://zstudiosltd.com/): Overview of zStudio, key features, and free download links for Mac, Windows, and Linux.
- [AI](https://zstudiosltd.com/ai): How to connect an AI tool to zStudio over MCP, write skills, and use local image models and the built-in AI Chat.
- [Pricing](https://zstudiosltd.com/pricing): zStudio is free; the only purchase is AI credit packs for cloud image models and the built-in AI Chat.
- [About](https://zstudiosltd.com/about): Background on zStudio: a non-intrusive visual scene editor for game teams and their AI tools.
- [zImporter](https://zstudiosltd.com/z-importer): The runtime library that imports zStudio scenes into Pixi.js (v7 and v8), Phaser, and plain HTML projects.
- [zImporter Guide](https://zstudiosltd.com/z-importer/guide): Usage tutorials with examples for Pixi.js, Phaser and HTML: loading scenes, buttons, toggles, sliders, scrollbars, states, text, animation, spawning, and moving assets without breaking the responsive layout.
- [zImporter AI skills](https://zstudiosltd.com/z-importer/guide/ai-skills): Every importer package includes skills in its skills/ folder that teach AI tools to use it correctly. Add the folder in zStudio under Help → AI Skill Libraries, or point an AI tool at node_modules/<package>/skills/.
- [SWF Importer](https://zstudiosltd.com/swf-importer): Tool for converting legacy Adobe Animate / Flash SWF assets into zStudio scenes.
- [Demos](https://zstudiosltd.com/demos): Interactive game demos built with zStudio and exported to Pixi.js/Phaser, including an interactive storybook and a space shooter.

## Documentation & Learning

- [Tutorials](https://zstudiosltd.com/tutorials): Video tutorials covering navigation, panels, containers/hierarchies, instancing, images, text, pivots/anchors, Spine, particles, saving/loading, portrait/landscape design, components, animation, scene validation, and the zImporter runtime workflow.
- [Full Documentation](https://zstudiosltd.com/zStudioDocumentation/index.html): Complete written documentation for zStudio.
